# circleci_group (Resource)

Manages a group in a CircleCI organization. Add users to it with `circleci_group_member`, and grant it a role on a project with `circleci_group_project_role`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "circleci_group" "platform" {
  organization_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  name            = "platform"
  description     = "The platform team"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the group.
- `organization_id` (String) The ID of the organization that owns the group. Changing this value forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the group. Defaults to an empty string.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the group.

## Import

Import is supported using `organization_id/group_id`:

```shell
terraform import circleci_group.example "<organization_id>/<group_id>"
```
